build_PatchEmbed_2D: build a PyTorch module that embeds 2D images into patch tokens using a convolutional projection layer
build_PatchEmbed3D_video: build a PyTorch module that embeds video frames into 3D tubelet patch tokens with temporal pooling
build_SinusoidalEmbed_position: build a PyTorch module that generates sinusoidal position embeddings for 1D, 2D, or 3D patch grids
test_PatchEmbed_flops: test the PatchEmbed flops method to calculate floating point operations for the convolutional projection
test_SinusoidalEmbed_forward_with_x: test the SinusoidalEmbed forward_with_x method to encode arbitrary coordinate tensors with sinusoidal frequency bands
